excerpt: '''Artio''' is a weaker variant of [[Callisto]] who is fought in the [[Hunter's End]], a [[singles-plus combat]] area in level 21 [[Wilderness]]. To enter Artio's lair, players must have completed the [[Wilderness Diary#Hard|hard Wilderness diary]], '''OR''' they must have a Callisto boss Slayer task (a bear Slayer task does not bypass the diary requirement).

In order to enter Callisto's lair, the player must have completed the medium [[Wilderness Diary]] tasks, '''OR''' they must have a Callisto boss Slayer task (a bear Slayer task does not bypass the diary requirement).

In order to enter Vet'ion's lair, the player must have completed the medium [[Wilderness Diary]] tasks, '''OR''' they must have a Vet'ion boss Slayer task (a skeleton Slayer task does not bypass the diary requirement).

In order to enter Venenatis' lair, the player must have completed the medium [[Wilderness Diary]] tasks, '''OR''' they must have a Venenatis boss Slayer task (a spider Slayer task does not bypass the diary requirement).
